name: Clear Lime Clone
description: A clear lime super juice that mimics the acidity of fresh lime juice while keeping the drink visually clear.
instructions: Combine 500 ml water, 20 g citric acid, 10 g malic acid, 0.5 g tartaric acid, 0.5 g potassium citrate, 5 g sugar, 1 g salt, and 3 drops lime essential oil.
